headline: BlumFest 2026: Robocop series and upcoming horror lineups revealed
post:
New York Comic Con brought plenty of scares as Blumhouse Atomic Monster hosted a massive panel filled with major announcements, according to The Hollywood Reporter. The studio shared a packed 2027 film slate including new takes on The Blair Witch Project and Paranormal Activity, plus a trailer debut for The Exorcist: Martyrs.

On the television side, Dan Stevens will reportedly star in a RoboCop series for Amazon Prime with the original writer Edward Neumeier. Meanwhile, LaKeith Stanfield discussed returning to the studio for Molepeople, a subterranean horror film directed by Rob Savage that promises to be intense.

From fresh video game adaptations like Amanda the Adventurer to sequels for Violent Night, creators shared exciting details about what is next. Which of these upcoming horror projects are you most eager to see?

#BlumFest #NYCC #HorrorMovies
original_title: BlumFest Haunts New York Comic Con 2026: All the Highlights From Blumhouse Atomic Monster

headline: Lance Bass reveals shockingly low *NSYNC earnings
post:
Did you know that *NSYNC fame did not always mean big bucks? According to Page Six, Lance Bass recently claimed on a podcast that he only received a $35 daily per diem and a meager $10,000 check after years of chart-topping albums and sold-out tours.

Bass alleged that the label and their late manager made a fortune while the band members worked essentially for free. Do you find these money revelations surprising?

#LanceBass #NSYNC #PageSix
original_title: Lance Bass reveals shockingly low amount he claims he earned while in *NSYNC: ‘Working for free’

headline: Danny Trejo Speaks Out On Movie Role
post:
Danny Trejo is speaking out after facing criticism for starring in Ben Shapiro's upcoming immigration enforcement movie, "Pawn Shop." The actor told TMZ that he is not pro-ICE, explaining that he simply views his job as a storyteller and was drawn to a positive script about a Latino character and veteran.

Sources shared that Danny plays a family shop owner who hires Harvey Keitel's character. 

How do you feel about actors taking on controversial roles? 🎬

#DannyTrejo #DailyWire #Movies
original_title: Danny Trejo Says He's Not Pro-ICE After Backlash Over Ben Shapiro Movie

headline: Jacob Myers-Norys reacts to Khloe Kardashian
post:
Remember when Khloe Kardashian left an innocent comment on a high school teacher's Instagram post? According to E! News, Jacob Myers-Norys recently shared a TikTok reacting to Khloe discussing his unrequited direct messages on the season eight premiere of The Kardashians.

During the episode, Khloe revealed that she left him on read after receiving multiple messages, jokingly telling him to "Calm down, Yacob." Instead of being upset about the public callout, the teacher had a great attitude about the whole ordeal.

Jacob compared the situation to his daily routine, noting on social media that he gets "roasted by high schoolers every single day." He ultimately decided to look on the bright side, writing in a caption, "at least I can say I made it onto The Kardashians."

Would you be embarrassed if a celebrity read your messages on TV? 

#TheKardashians #KhloeKardashian #RealityTV
original_title: Teacher Reacts to Khloe Kardashian Making Fun of Him for Flirting
